spanish: Cinco las cortinas estarán juntándose, mujer a su hermana, y cinco cortinas juntándose, mujer a su hermana.
grammarChanges: Clause 1 (h02026003003+h02026003004): replaced the passive 'serán juntadas' with the active periphrastic 'estarán juntándose' so the curtains are the ones joining, not the ones being joined, matching the qal active participle.
Clause 2 (h02026003010): replaced the passive 'juntadas' with the active gerund 'juntándose,' keeping the clause without its own auxiliary verb, as in the source.
readerNote: Both qal active participles now read as 'juntándose' (the ones joining) instead of the passive 'juntadas' (the ones joined); the second clause stays without its own auxiliary, matching the elided copula in the source.
